name: Ishibashi Jun'ichirou
source:
Bank employee at Yotsuba Bank, and copy editor at Nadeshiko Productions.
An absolutely normal guy from a normal family with a normal bank job.
Higuchi saw him while dropping by the bank one day and became obsessed with him and invited him to a company tour.
He gets manipulated by Higuchi, but he's just excited to see inside the voice acting industry.
